basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Bhopal Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 4 Project Research Scientist, Project Technical Support Posts
basic_details.post_name: Project Research Scientist-II (Medical), Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical), Project Technical Support-III
basic_details.short_information: All India Institute of Medical Sciences Bhopal (AIIMS Bhopal), Madhya Pradesh, has invited applications for 4 posts in 3 roles under Advt No. AIIMS Bhopal/ TM/ NOHM/ 2026/ 2825. The posts include Project Research Scientist-II (Medical), Project Research Scientist-II (Non-Medical), Project Technical Support-III. Applications go by email to [email protected] and must be sent by 25 November 2026.

age_limit.age_details: Maximum 35 years (as on the last date of application)
age_limit.details: Age relaxation for all posts: SC/ST/OBC As per rules / Central Government instructions, Retrenched Government Employees As per Central Government instructions, Departmental Candidates (including projects) As per Central Government instructions, Ex-servicemen As per Central Government instructions, Experienced and skilled persons To the extent of services rendered in research projects.

qualification.education_qualification: PRS-II (Medical): MBBS/BVSc/BDS with 3 years' experience, or with PG degree, or with PhD. PRS-II (Non-Medical): PG degree with 3 years' experience or PhD, or 4-year Engineering/IT/CS graduate degree with 3 years' experience. PTS-III: 3-year graduate degree in relevant field + 3 years' experience or PG in relevant field, or 4-year Engineering/IT/CS graduate degree.

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: MBBS / BVSc / BDS with three years' post-qualification experience; or MBBS / BVSc / BDS + Post Graduate Degree (MD/MVSc./ MDS/MPH) or any equivalent degree, including integrated PG degrees; or MBBS/BVSc/ BDS with PhD. Experience required: Three years' post-qualification experience under option 1. Age limit: Maximum 35 years. Pay: Rs 80,000 per month + 20% HRA. Qualification required: Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degrees, with three years post-qualification experience or PhD; For Engineering / IT / CS - Graduate degree of Four Years with three years' post qualification experience. Experience required: Three years' post-qualification experience where stated. Age limit: Maximum 35 years. Pay: Rs 67,000 per month + 20% HRA. Qualification required: T

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 28,000 to Rs. 80,000 per month, depending on the post

exam_pattern.details: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the written test/interview

how_to_apply: Download the application form enclosed with the advertisement or from http://aiimsbhopal.edu.in/jobs.aspx.
Fill the form and paste a recent passport-size photograph.
Combine the form, covering letter, detailed CV and self-attested documents into a single PDF.
Email the single PDF to [email protected] latest by 25/11/2026.
No hard copy needs to be sent.
important_instructions: Employed candidates must submit a No Objection Certificate at the time of written test/interview Bring original certificates, two passport size colour photographs and one set of self-attested photocopies to the test/interview, failing which participation is not allowed Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected All updates including interview date, result and joining will be on www.aiimsbhopal.edu.in

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Initially up to one year; extendable up to the duration of the project, subject to satisfactory performance No right to regular appointment or permanent absorption in AIIMS Bhopal or ICMR Contract can be terminated by either side with 30 days' notice or salary in lieu Leave governed by ICMR leave policy for extramural research projects No hostel or accommodation provided

content_sections.heading: How Will AIIMS Bhopal Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting depending on the number of applications Written Test/Skill Test and/or Interview Candidates shortlisted for written test/skill test and/or interview depending on number of applications Date, time and venue intimated to shortlisted candidates by e-mail Shortlisted candidates must report not later than 09.00 A.M. on the intimated date Venue (unless otherwise intimated): Department of Translational Medicine, Ground Floor of the Nursing College Building, AIIMS Bhopal

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form with a recent passport-size photograph Covering letter and detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV) Self-attested proof of date of birth (Class 10th certificate/school leaving certificate) Self-attested mark-sheets, degrees, experience certificate and caste certificate Qualifying degree registration with statutory council (if applicable) Other certificates/testimonials the candidate wishes to show the selection committee
